item_name: Rothco Police Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Police Patch With Hook Back is great for attaching to a variety of law enforcement gear, including tactical vests and operator caps.
description: Rothco’s Police Patch With Hook Back is great for attaching to a variety of law enforcement gear, including tactical vests and operator caps. Featuring a black background and white “Police” lettering, the law enforcement patch is made of a high-quality construction for long-lasting durability. The police vest patch is available in small (2 ½” X 5 ¾”) and large (4” X 10 ¾”).
